notes.title: June 8, 2025 Trial Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
・Implemented auto-save at the start of each turn

・Implemented an option to skip the tutorial at the start from the title screen

・Adjusted the game so that you can advance from the first turn of Map Mode after starting the game

・Balance adjustments (adjusted to make the game easier at the start)

・Enhanced faction bosses (level enhancements, no cooldown when defeated during advancement, etc.)
